baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins covering at word 2, an unrecovered stumble at word 3, loss at word 5, and intentional action at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering removes usable orientation; intended acts then lose their route, trip, and become unrecoverable to their makers. The verse describes a failure process, not only a verdict appended after otherwise intact deeds.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the occlusion that deprives action of visible orientation.
A bodily trip and downward pitch without recovery turns the consequence into kinetic collapse.
Loss from a possessor makes the products of action unavailable to those who performed them.
Purposeful action supplies the directed projects whose course and recovery fail.

changed_reading.before: A general curse followed by the cancellation of bad deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their own covering produces an orientation failure in which deliberate projects lose their route, fall, and cannot be recovered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The uncommon noun at word 3 can concern missing an argument or sought object, while words 5-6 name deviation affecting purposeful acts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The projects need not disappear materially. They may continue as exertion yet miss the end they seek and fail the claim they were meant to establish; failure is measured against their own intention.

activation_trace.role: Missing one's proof or sought object supplies precise failure at the level of claim and aim.
Deviation from a goal supplies the trajectory by which effort misses its intended end.
Intentional action makes the failed end internal to the projects rather than imposed as an unrelated theme.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds are erased after completion.
changed_reading.after: Their deliberate efforts can remain busy and visible while failing both the object sought and the case those efforts purport to prove.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive relation in the focus attaches the lost object to its makers, while the work inventory includes earned return and human transaction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Loss can occur at the link between worker, work, and return: activity is performed, but its product no longer arrives as a claimable yield. This carries a live economic or legal register alongside the moral and spatial readings.

activation_trace.role: A thing departing its possessor supplies severance between actors and the yield attributed to them.
The earned return of labor supplies the possibility that what is lost is realizable credit, not physical activity.
Interpersonal dealing locates the loss within an exchange relation between action and outcome.

changed_reading.before: The deeds themselves simply cease to exist.
changed_reading.after: The activity may exist, yet the bond by which its maker receives a valid product, credit, or return is severed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier parallel supplies an explicit traversable path and deliberate diversion from it before repeating the focus predicate. That makes the later loss reflexive: projects devoted to diverting movement are themselves deprived of a viable route.

activation_trace.role: Turning others aside supplies the obstructive action that is returned upon the actors' projects.
An extended traveled way supplies the concrete trajectory from which both people and works can be diverted.
Deviation from the intended course receives a specific path mechanism from the earlier parallel.
Purposeful acts remain the focus object whose direction is reflexively undone.

structural_cues: 47:1 repeats the focus actors and final predicate but inserts explicit path obstruction before the predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, a traveled path, and the repeated work-loss clause; I supply the reflexive arrow from blocking a route to one's own projects becoming route-less. A live alternative is simple punitive consequence without reflexive mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Their works lose direction for an unspecified reason.
changed_reading.after: The works that implement path obstruction undergo the same obstruction and become unable to reach their own destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding promise defines successful action as relational support that stabilizes feet. The focus then presents its inverse: without that stabilizing relation, actors and their projects lose footing and pitch down.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal aid supplies the enabling relation that lets purposeful movement hold together.
Active strengthening supplies the direct opposite of the focus collapse.
The literal foot gives the contrast a bodily support point rather than a merely abstract success condition.
The unrecovered stumble realizes the inverse of strengthened feet.
Intentional projects share the actors' loss of stable support.

structural_cues: The stable-feet promise in 47:7 stands immediately before the focus stumble formula in 47:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal support, strengthened feet, and then an unrecovered stumble; I infer a binary in which relation provides the footing of action. Alternatively, the adjacency may be rhetorical contrast without specifying a causal substrate for works.

changed_reading.before: The curse is a free-standing wish for ruin.
changed_reading.after: Ruin is the inverse of supported footing: once the enabling relation is absent, both the people and the projects standing on it collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah ties aversion to what was delivered down with the downward collapse of works. This creates a vertical counterflow: refusing the arriving guidance does not preserve autonomy; it sends the actors' own constructions downward.

activation_trace.role: Affective aversion supplies the active refusal rather than mere lack of information.
Delivery from above supplies the incoming orientation that is rejected.
Downward collapse supplies the resulting direction of the works.
The focus fall is sharpened as the bodily counterpart of the works' downward movement.
Purposeful constructions are what enter the counterflow.

structural_cues: 47:9 immediately follows the focus and gives an explicit causal reason before repeating work-collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aversion, downward delivery, and a second predicate of work-collapse; I supply the spatial reversal in which refused descent produces the descent of one's projects. The alternative is a causal explanation with no intended vertical wordplay.

changed_reading.before: Their projects are lost in a directionless way.
changed_reading.after: They reject an offered downward delivery, and their own intentional constructions answer by falling downward instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bad project can be cosmetically improved to its maker while desire supplies its direction; locked inward evaluation then prevents deliberation over consequences. The work is objectively astray but subjectively registers as successful, so ordinary corrective feedback never begins.

activation_trace.role: Applied beautification supplies a false positive appearance around a bad project.
Personal inclination supplies the steering signal followed in place of a sound route.
Considering an affair through its outcome supplies the missing corrective operation.
Hard closure supplies the block that prevents inward revision.
Objective deviation persists beneath the work's improved subjective appearance.
The feedback failure remains anchored in deliberate projects rather than becoming a general psychology.

structural_cues: 47:14 places improved appearance on bad work before desire-following; 47:24 later pairs absent consequence-reading with inward locks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adornment, inclination, outcome-oriented reflection, and closure; I connect them as a false-positive feedback loop that sustains misdirected work. A live alternative treats adornment and locking as separate descriptions rather than phases of one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Lost works should look unsuccessful even to their makers.
changed_reading.after: A work can be deeply lost while appearing improved from inside a closed evaluative loop, which explains why its maker does not correct course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context depicts a return backward after orientation had become visible. Enticement makes reversal attractive and temporal extension lets it persist, so the focus loss can be read as rollback and decommissioning of an already disclosed trajectory rather than primordial confusion.

activation_trace.role: Returning a thing backward supplies the rollback motion.
Prior visibility removes simple ignorance as the only explanation for the reversal.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the trajectory that had already been available.
Enticing presentation supplies the attraction that masks the cost of rollback.
Extended time supplies persistence, allowing reversal to harden into a continuing course.
The focus deviation becomes the result of an enacted rollback from known direction.

structural_cues: 47:25 orders backward return, prior clarification, guidance, enticement, and extension as one temporal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a backward turn after visible guidance plus enticement and delay; I infer that these deactivate an already oriented work-trajectory. The alternative is that the sequence describes persons only, with work-loss remaining a separate judgment.

changed_reading.before: The actors and their works never possessed any orientation.
changed_reading.after: Their work is rolled back after a route has become visible, then the attractive reversal is prolonged until it functions as the new course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later commands distinguish active invalidation of works from a guarantee that valid work will not be reduced. This sharpens the focus economic reading: the loss is not arbitrary underpayment but cancellation of the work's claim when its governing relation is broken.

activation_trace.role: Relational compliance supplies the condition under which work remains attached to a valid course.
Active removal supplies a preventable mode by which the efficacy of work is cancelled.
Denied reduction of a right or work supplies the protected accounting contrast.
Loss from the possessor describes the failed claim that the later guarantee excludes for valid work.
Earned return lets the work language participate in an accounting mechanism without replacing its moral sense.

structural_cues: 47:33 coordinates two obedience commands with a prohibition on invalidating works; 47:35 later promises no reduction of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active invalidation and an explicit non-reduction guarantee; I infer a contrast between self-cancellation and underpayment. A live alternative takes all three work predicates as interchangeable descriptions of lost reward.

changed_reading.before: The focus says that completed labor is simply denied its due.
changed_reading.after: The work's claim is cancelled by rupture in its governing relation, while work that remains valid is explicitly protected from being shortchanged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This agricultural activation is surprising because it uses a form-distant covering branch, yet it remains anchored in the focus roots for covering, disappearance, and intentional work and gains a benefit-as-fruit cue at 47:15. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not claim that the focus lexically denotes farming.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can align seed-covering at word 2 with disappearance below the surface at word 5 and purposeful investment at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Placing seed under soil supplies a productive-looking act of concealment whose eventual emergence is at issue.
Disappearance into earth supplies burial without visible return.
Purposeful acts function as the invested material expected to yield an outcome.
Benefit figured as fruit supplies the missing yield against which buried work fails.

changed_reading.before: The works are erased like entries from a ledger.
changed_reading.after: The works resemble an investment placed under cover that never surfaces as benefit: burial occurs, but germination into usable fruit does not.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This metabolic model is odd because it treats a bodily branch as an analogy for projects, but the next ayah applies that root directly to works and later places disbelieving activity beside animal-like consumption. It should be rendered as a qualified image of false expansion, never as a literal physiological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus stumble at word 3 and purposeful works at word 6 can receive a bodily failure mechanism from the repeated work predicate in 47:9.

activation_trace.role: An unrecovered bodily collapse supplies the endpoint of pathological expansion.
Purposeful activity is the entity whose apparent growth can mask dysfunction.
Swelling caused by harmful intake supplies apparent enlargement that is actually a failure state.
Repeated consumption supplies the intake process that can enlarge without directing action toward a sound end.
Livestock supplies the explicit comparison that keeps the metabolic image connected to the actors in context.

changed_reading.before: Nullified work must be empty, small, or visibly absent.
changed_reading.after: Lost work may expand impressively through indiscriminate intake while that very expansion is pathological and ends in collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it scales personal work-loss into institutional succession, but the plural focus, the work branch concerning entrusted office, and the explicit replacement of one people by another keep it anchored. Downstream prose should say the verse can resonate at collective scale, not assert direct transfer of particular projects.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural actors possess works at word 6, whose inventory includes assigned office, while word 5 permits those works to depart their possessors.

activation_trace.role: Loss from a possessor supplies removal of functional control from one collective.
Entrusted office supplies an institutional scale for the works that can be lost.
Turning away supplies the collective breach that precedes replacement.
One entity standing in another's place supplies functional succession.
A human collective supplies the scale at which succession occurs.
Difference from the displaced group prevents replacement from being mere continuation under the same pattern.

changed_reading.before: Only isolated individuals lose private moral credits.
changed_reading.after: A collective can lose custody and efficacy of its work-role, after which a genuinely different people occupies the functional place it abandoned.

strongest_changes: The repeated clause in 47:1 makes work-loss reflexive path obstruction rather than unspecified cancellation.
The immediate 47:7 contrast turns the focus curse into loss of the relational footing on which projects stand.
Adornment, desire, and locked consequence-reading allow objectively lost work to look successful from inside its own feedback loop.
Later rollback, invalidation, and non-diminution language distinguishes self-cancelled work from arbitrarily withheld reward.
summary.what_was_special: The terse focus supports simultaneous kinetic, directional, epistemic, accounting, agricultural, metabolic, and collective mechanisms. Context repeatedly changes the reading without forcing those mechanisms into one compromise: routes can be blocked, feet destabilized, known guidance rolled back, work cosmetically misread, claims cancelled, and social functions replaced.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether work-loss foregrounds causal disorientation, a resulting state, or final evaluation remains open.
The accounting, seed, and metabolic branches are well anchored but materially distant and require explicit qualification in prose.
The collective replacement cue supports loss of function more securely than literal transfer of any particular project.
